stock.description: Farnova Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on providing advertising services throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's business activities are categorized into three core segments: Advertising, Vehicle Sales, and Securities Investments. In addition to advertising, it is involved in the sale of new energy electric vehicles and actively engages in the investment and trading of securities. Founded in 2000, the entity was formerly known as Code Agriculture (Holdings) Limited before officially changing its name to Farnova Group Holdings Limited in May 2020. Its headquarters are situated in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
